title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-21
content:
Morning brain dump - sprint launch week (day 3)

Top priorities for today:
- Finalize PRD edits based on eng + SRE feedback (see comments in PRD doc). Need to resolve KV cache behavior section and add fallback policy table.
- Follow up with SRE on canary traffic shift schedule + rollback SLA.
- Get legal sign-off on data retention language for private deployments page.
- Prepare launch checklist for tomorrow's dry run with SEs.

Standup notes:
- Diego: infra smoke tests passed on dev cluster; will run perf suite at 11:30. Needs clarified latency SLO table updated in PRD (done, pushed comment).
- Priya: console rollout UI copy ready; wants final copy by EOD.
- SRE (Marcos): canary plan ready but needs final capacity numbers from infra (Diego to confirm by noon).

PRD edits (what I changed / need to do):
- Added "Fallback routing" subsection with policy variants (latency-first, cost-first). TODO: add the exact weights and thresholds (SRE/infra input).
- Rewrote "KV cache assumptions" to reflect continuous batching change: mention impact on cold-start token overhead and how cache TTLs affect billing.
- Inserted rollout matrix (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) and criteria for each step (error rate <0.5%, p95 latency < target). Need to confirm exact p95 numbers with benchmarking results (Diego).
- Open question: do we enable model-variant fallback across regions for initial canary? Ops/legal concern about cross-region data movement. Action: ask Legal + Ops.

Stakeholder follow-ups (who I need to ping):
- Marcos (SRE): confirm rollback window and automated rollback triggers. Slack DM after perf run.
- Jen (Legal): quick read of two lines in PRD re: retention & cross-region fallback. Ask for explicit approval or suggested wording.
- Sam (Solutions Eng): coordinate dry-run schedule with two enterprise customers (one in EU, one in US) to validate regional routing.
- Growth: confirm docs/announcement page embargo (need publish time).

Launch checklist (draft - dry run tomorrow):
- Pre-launch (today):
  - [ ] PRD final review (Aisha, Diego, Priya)
  - [ ] Legal quick sign-off on retention language (Jen)
  - [ ] Confirm infra numbers for canary (Diego)
  - [ ] Update console copy in staging (Priya)
  - [ ] Prepare monitoring dashboards (Observability team)
- Dry run (tomorrow 09:00-10:30 PT):
  - [ ] Run synthetic traffic against canary (SRE + infra)
  - [ ] Validate logs, traces, cost memos (observability)
  - [ ] Customer-facing runbook dry-run (SE + support)
  - [ ] Confirm rollback works end-to-end (automated + manual)
- Rollout day:
  - [ ] Shift 10% traffic -> monitor 20m -> criteria check -> shift to 50% etc.
  - [ ] Notify customers via status page if any deviation

Action items (short):
- Aisha: merge PRD changes + ping Legal for quick read (by 2pm).
- Diego: perf numbers and p95 target confirmation (by 12pm).
- Priya: staging copy pushed + share QA notes (by EOD).
- Marcos (SRE): smoke + canary automation scripts (ready for dry run).

Risks / open blockers:
- Legal might require stricter data locality language for EU customers - could force region-only fallback for EU tenants. Need contingency text in PRD.
- Observability: missing a per-route cost breakdown in staging dashboards (observability team says adding today, but confirm).
- Model fallback: if we route to smaller quantized variant during high load, need to document expected quality regression and customer-facing phrasing.

Notes to self / rough thoughts:
- Consider adding a small note in release notes about "quality-variable fallback" so SEs can set expectations with pilots.
- Post-launch: schedule a quick retro 48hrs after rollout to review cost delta.

Meetings today:
- 10:00 AM PT - Canary run sync (SRE, infra, me)
- 11:30 AM PT - Perf results review (Diego)
- 03:00 PM PT - Legal quick sync (Jen)
- 04:00 PM PT - SE dry run prep (Sam, Priya)

Quick links (tickets / docs):
- PRD doc: confluence link above
- Benchmark ticket: PROD-1023
- Canary automation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789

End-of-day checklist:
- [ ] PRD merged
- [ ] Legal comment resolved
- [ ] Dry-run go/no-go decision

Random TODOs / scratch:
- Draft internal email to CS about expected behavior during canary (bullet points).
- Add a short snippet to docs about how we handle " KV cache TTL " impacts on billed tokens (for SEs).

----
Small personal note: lunch at 12:30 with Priya - keep it short, bring the canary checklist.
